latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Automation Workflows skill for solopreneurs.
- Guide covers automation opportunity identification, workflow design, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), setup/testing, and ongoing maintenance.
- Step-by-step playbook for auditing tasks, comparing tools, designing workflows, building and testing, and monitoring automations.
- Includes checklists, templates, and examples for common use cases such as lead capture, invoicing, onboarding, and content distribution.
- Focuses on no-code solutions to help save time and reduce manual work across tools.
